outcome: detection of pathogenic genetic variants (diagnostic yield of WES)
cohort: 280 children diagnosed with unexplained developmental delay or intellectual disability.
finding: Whole exome sequencing identified pathogenic variants in 73 cases (36.07%) of children with unexplained developmental delay or intellectual disability.
mod_finding: A significant correlation was observed between delivery mode and positive WES results, with a higher diagnostic yield among patients delivered via caesarean section.
